Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Automation Engineer
Message:
feat: add quota polling, credit fallback, and rolling windows

Poll GET https://api.z.ai/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit per enabled
account with Bearer auth on a jittered 60-180s cadence (bounded
timeout, response size, redirects, and ambient proxy). Parse
CREDIT_LIMIT unit 3/number 5 as the five-hour bucket and unit 6/number
1 as the weekly bucket; currentValue/usage is authoritative
utilization and nextResetTime (epoch ms) is the authoritative reset.

On endpoint failure, non-200, or invalid/incomplete payloads the
plugin falls back to fixed-point estimates from
pluginapi.UsageRecord: GLM-5.3 (input*6.9 + cached*1.7 + output*24) /
10,000 and GLM-5.3-Flash (2.3, 0.56, 8), as microcredit integers with
big.Int intermediates. Cached pricing binds to CacheReadTokens only;
CacheCreationTokens is priced at the input rate and generic
CachedTokens is never priced. Off-peak requests are billed at 0.5x
(peak is Mon-Fri 06:00-10:00 UTC). Estimates use rolling five-hour and
seven-day windows keyed on the account, with bounded hash dedup that
inserts events chronologically so late-arriving records stay
persistable.

The management status route now reports per-account quota source
(authoritative/estimated), utilization, reset times, staleness, and
estimator integrity warnings. usage.handle stays best-effort: CPA
discards RPC errors, so persistence failures surface as warnings, not
failed responses. Only non-secret quota state is persisted; keys
appear in no persisted state, errors, or logs.

Also removes two dead hardening helpers and a capitalized error
string flagged by lint, and makes runtimeState a pointer global so
tests stop copying a mutex.

Author: togetherweown[bot]
Message:
feat: config, account pairing, and secure settings store (#8)

Implements config validation, CPA config projection, exact-key pairing of Z.ai Anthropic and zai-coding-plan OpenAI-compatible entries, CPA v7.2.67-compatible stable auth-ID generation, account overrides, and atomic 0700/0600 state and settings storage under <auth-dir>/zai-coding-plan/.

Invalid initial configuration fails closed. Invalid reconfiguration retains the last valid snapshot and still returns a valid registration, surfacing the rejected validation error through bounded redacted status fields. Shutdown cancels and synchronously joins background quota workers before flushing.

Closes TOG-1556.

Reviews: TOG-1682 (code, approved), TOG-1683 (security, approved; narrow CodeQL go/weak-sensitive-data-hashing waiver at src/accounts.go:71 for non-security auth-ID compatibility bytes).
